verdict.rationale: Otter documents scheduling its Notetaker to automatically join all Zoom, Teams, and Google Meet meetings. Community reports confirm the bot does join meetings on users' behalf, sometimes unexpectedly or repeatedly, which corroborates auto-capture but suggests weak user control. There is no evidence of an explicit one-time Google/Outlook calendar connection or of per-meeting-type rules governing which meetings get captured. Missing for 10: documented Google/Outlook calendar connection, per-meeting-type auto-capture rules (e.g. internal vs external, organizer-only), and evidence that users can reliably control or stop auto-join.
